title: Classic dashboard widget
description: Captured-HTML tile for an un-ported classic dashboard widget bridged into the dashboard-host grid (#134). Lazily fetches the widget's rendered HTML and renders it at admin trust, with a per-tile iframe fallback to classic index.php.

widgetId.description: Classic dashboard meta-box id (REST endpoint key).

title.description: Display title harvested from the meta-box.

documentation.purpose: Render half of the classic dashboard-widget bridge (#134). One shared tile app the PHP harvest mounts once per surviving plugin dashboard widget, with per-tile config.widgetId. Fetches that widget's captured HTML lazily so a slow widget doesn't block the grid. Surfaces un-ported third-party dashboard widgets in the workspace without anyone writing shell config — the dashboard sibling of the #128 admin-bar / notices chrome harvest.

reads.purpose: Lazy per-tile fetch of the classic widget's ob_start-captured HTML (admin trust). Non-entity HTML capture — the documented api-fetch exception. The endpoint re-runs wp_dashboard_setup, locates the callback by id, buffers its echoed HTML, and returns { id, title, html }. Permission floor: logged-in + read; the requested id must be a non-core widget the bridge surfaces (404 otherwise).
Base URL for the iframe-fallback src (classic index.php, chromeless).

states.when: the per-tile fetch is in flight (status === 'loading')

states.renders: The captured classic-widget HTML injected via dangerouslySetInnerHTML (admin trust).

states.when: the fetch resolved but the widget rendered no HTML
the fetch rejected, or no widgetId was supplied (status === 'error')
states.renders: An error message pointing the user at the classic-view toggle.

states.when: the user clicks 'Open classic dashboard' (useIframe === true)
states.renders: An iframe of classic index.php (chromeless). wp-admin has no single-widget URL, so this is the ENTIRE classic dashboard (every widget), not just this tile's widget — but the widget's own enqueued JS runs natively there.

interactions.effect: Toggles between the captured-HTML render and the chromeless classic-dashboard iframe (the whole dashboard, not a single widget).

constraints.note: Captured HTML is injected via dangerouslySetInnerHTML; React does not execute injected <script> tags, and the widget's enqueued JS / AJAX handles are not loaded on the shell page. Widgets that depend on JS (live feeds, interactive charts) degrade to static HTML. The per-tile iframe fallback ('Open classic dashboard') is the fidelity path — it loads classic index.php (the ENTIRE classic dashboard, since wp-admin has no single-widget URL) where the widget's own JS runs. Same escape-hatch tier as the #128 notices iframe fallback.

The captured HTML is admin-context — identical to what classic wp-admin echoes for the same widget — rendered unchanged via dangerouslySetInnerHTML inside the already-admin-gated workspace. Same author-trust boundary as TrustedNodeTitle / the notices buffer (#128). The endpoint only returns HTML for a widget the dashboard registered this request and which is NOT a shell-native core widget.
